city.name: Philadelphia
city.regionLabel: Philadelphia, nearby suburbs and a sensible drive

events.title: Emerald City Weekend at Longwood Gardens
events.description: Longwood goes to Oz with themed music, evening activities and the new Journey to Oz illuminated fountain show at 8:15 PM. Timed garden admission is required.
events.priceLabel: Included with garden admission; Check source

events.title: Marcel Duchamp: Major Retrospective
events.description: Explore Duchamp’s paintings, readymades, film and experiments in a major retrospective. Reserve a timed exhibition slot and allow extra time for the entry queue; museum admission is included.
events.time: Museum 10:00 AM–8:45 PM; timed exhibition entry

events.title: Science After Hours: Fright Nite
events.description: An adults-only museum night explores the science of horror movies with demonstrations, entertainment and exhibit access. Costumes are welcome; rooftop stargazing is weather dependent and tickets are limited.

events.title: Comedy Night with Brendan Donegan
events.description: Brendan Donegan headlines an evening of stand-up at the Farmhouse. Choose comedy only or a package with the pre-show buffet; the optional dinner runs from 6 to 7:30 PM.

events.title: Fright Factory
events.description: Explore three frightening warehouse environments at this indoor haunted attraction. Arrive early for queues; the ticket booth closes thirty minutes before the attraction, and online sales stop at 7 PM.

events.title: Girl from the North Country
events.description: Bob Dylan’s songs thread through a Depression-era boarding-house story. Friday and Saturday matinee performances offer open captioning and audio description; Saturday evening is also Teen Night.

events.title: Movies on the Mall: Hocus Pocus
events.description: Bring a blanket or chair for the season’s final free outdoor movie. Family activities start before the screening, with free popcorn and visitor-center restrooms available.

events.title: Philadelphia TASTE! Festival
events.description: Taste food, wine and spirits and watch chef demonstrations at this adults-only festival. Each ticket covers one session; Saturday’s daytime and evening sessions require separate admission.

events.title: Philly Music Fest: Owen Stewart and Friends
events.description: Owen Stewart, Nik Greeley, Sug Daniels, Roberta Faceplant and the Flying Vees share a locally rooted bill. Check the current official ticket page before heading to this intimate venue.

events.title: Pumpkinland at Linvilla Orchards
events.description: Walk through Linvilla’s seasonal pumpkin displays and visit the farm animals. Hayrides, mazes, pumpkins and other activities are priced separately and have shorter operating hours than the grounds.
events.priceLabel: Free entry; activities and purchases extra

events.title: Rebecca Black: Exhibitionism on Tour
events.description: Rebecca Black brings her Exhibitionism tour to Union Transfer with BAYLI. This is an all-ages concert, with doors opening an hour before showtime.

events.title: The Addams Family: The Musical
events.description: Wednesday Addams falls for a boy from a very different family, setting up a musical collision over dinner. Catch this seasonal comedy at Philadelphia’s historic Walnut Street Theatre.

events.title: The Bald and the Beautiful Live
events.description: Trixie Mattel and Katya bring their live comedy and beauty-culture conversation to Philadelphia. Check the official listing for current seating, ticket prices and entry guidance.

events.title: Manayunk Fall Fest
events.address: Main Street at Cotton and Grape streets, Philadelphia, PA
events.description: Local makers, food trucks, live music and family activities fill Manayunk. The mac n’ cheese crawl requires its own ticket; Main Street remains open while side streets close.

events.title: Philly Bike Ride
events.address: N 22nd St & Benjamin Franklin Pkwy, Philadelphia, PA
events.description: Ride 20 miles of car-free streets in the city’s big recreational cycling event. Registration is required; corrals close at 7:15 AM, before the ride begins.
events.time: 7:30 AM; corrals open 6:00 AM, close 7:15 AM

events.title: Revolutionary Philadelphia: 1776
events.venue: Museum of the American Revolution plaza and nearby historic sites
events.description: Meet costumed artisans and residents of Revolutionary Philadelphia through free outdoor interpretation. Public readings, craft demonstrations and short dramatic encounters bring the anxious autumn of 1776 to life.
events.priceLabel: Outdoor programs free; museum and guided tour extra
events.time: Programs from 10:00 AM; final listed plaza reading 3:00 PM

events.title: Scrapple & Apple Festival
events.description: Market merchants serve special scrapple-and-apple dishes for one day, with cooking demonstrations, entertainment and family activities. Entry is free; bring a food budget.

events.title: Adults’ Learn-to-Ride Biking Class
events.description: A free introductory class covers balance, pedaling, stopping and steering for adults and older teens. Check registration and the latest weather notice before making the trip.

events.title: Boo at the Zoo at Elmwood Park Zoo
events.description: Wear a costume and bring a treat bag for trick-or-treat stations, games, a straw maze and music around the zoo. The Halloween program is included with regular paid zoo admission.
events.priceLabel: Included with zoo admission; Check source

events.title: Drive-In Zoovies: Hocus Pocus 2
events.description: Watch the Sanderson sisters return from the comfort of your car at the zoo’s drive-in screening. Tickets are per person, and every party must indicate its car count when booking.

events.title: East FallsFest
events.address: Ridge Ave & Midvale Ave, Philadelphia, PA
events.description: Spend an autumn afternoon with neighborhood food, local makers, live music and pumpkin decorating. Wissahickon Brewing hosts the beer garden, with family activities throughout the day.

events.title: Fall Fun Day with ECRS
events.description: Choose from dancing, singing, crafts, cooperative games and theater exercises, then join a potluck dinner and evening activities. Come for the full day or a shorter visit.

events.title: Fireworks Tour: Flash! Bang! Boom!
events.description: Take a guided look at the chemistry and international history of fireworks. This roughly fifty-minute tour is first-come, first-served and limited to twenty people.
